Subject: Can't complete supplier onboarding — endless consent redirect

Hi Logan,

We're trying to accept the supplier invite for Sun River Supplies but after we authenticate via our IdP the page just bounces back to the consent screen in a loop. We followed the link in the invite (zip onboarding) and are able to log into our IdP (Okta) fine — we see the SAML assertion in the browser but the portal keeps redirecting to the same consent page.

I've attached a screenshot of what we see (sso-error-screenshot.png) and a saml-trace.txt from the browser console. Can you advise what is failing on Redwood's side? Our procurement team is blocked from receiving POs.

Thanks,

Subject: Re: Can't complete supplier onboarding — endless consent redirect

Hi Jordan — thanks for the detailed notes and the traces, super helpful.

Quick gut check: this looks like our consent handshake is not seeing the RelayState returned by your IdP (RelayState gets dropped or rewritten), so the portal treats the request as a fresh onboarding attempt and re-asks for consent — hence the loop. Two quick asks:

1) Can you confirm the NameID format your IdP is sending (emailAddress vs persistent)? If you can paste the SAML <NameID> value from saml-trace.txt that will help.

2) As a workaround, can you try hitting the invite link with a query param we control to skip the transient consent page (we can enable for your tenant only). If that works we'll patch the RelayState handling.

I'll loop Ben for the implementation and Marissa for procurement priorities. In parallel I'll open a SUP ticket and attach your traces.

Next steps from our side: Ben will enable a tenant-scoped bypass flag and I'll coordinate timing (we can do within 1–2 hours). If it succeeds, we will then push a small fix to the RelayState parser and do a rollback test.

Sorry for the friction — we'll try to get you back online ASAP.

— Logan
Logan Wright
Senior Platform PM, Redwood Inference
logan_wright@redwood.com

Logan,

I dug into the logs for tenant sunriver-supplies.com. Quick findings:
- Our SAML consumer received the assertion and returned HTTP 302 back to /onboard/consent with RelayState empty.
- IdP assertion contains NameID in 'emailAddress' format (jordan.pike@sunriver-supplies.com).
- There's an additional cookie flagged by their domain (SameSite=None) that our browser-layer rejects in headless tests — could explain case-by-case failures.

I'll flip the tenant-scoped bypass flag for the consent page (redwood-admin toggle) and post the temporary link within 10 minutes. If their team can try the link in an incognito window (clears cookies), that will help us isolate cookie vs RelayState rewriting.

Ben
